milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate/observe task. The player must navigate toward the open-front workshop and look at the smithing table placed at spawn-relative [5, 1, 5]. max_distance=10 ensures the player has moved closer to the workshop (spawn distance is ~7.1 blocks, so they must at least face it from near spawn or approach further), and facing_tolerance=60 ensures they are actually looking toward the smithing table rather than accidentally triggering completion while facing away.
